name: Neo Performance Materials Inc.
summary: Neo Performance Materials Inc. engages in the manufacture and sale of rare earth, magnetic powders, magnets, and rare metal-based functional materials in China, Japan, Thailand, South Korea, North America, Europe, and internationally. It operates in three segments: Magnequench, Chemicals & Oxides, and Rare Metals.
